summary: Verified the BLE payload structure fix end-to-end via the on-screen 'payload-preview' element and code review. All 11 expected flat keys are present with correct JS types and NO extras/nesting. UUIDs in ble.ts match spec. Geocoding via Zippopotam.us runs BEFORE the payload is built (both live-preview useEffect and handleSync). Live payload updates correctly on toggle/input edits and zip changes. Note: actual BLE write cannot be exercised in web preview (native module) — this is expected and clearly gated via isBleSupported() with a visible hint.
critical_code_review_comments: payload.ts is a pure function with an exact type contract — good. Trims whitespace on strings before writing.

ble.ts SERVICE_UUID='4fafc201-1fb5-459e-8fcc-c5c9c331914b' and CHARACTERISTIC_UUID='beb5483e-36e1-4688-b7f5-ea07361b26a8' — confirmed match. writeCharacteristic{With,Without}ResponseForService is called against these UUIDs in syncSettings().
geocode.ts uses https://api.zippopotam.us/us/{zip} (no key) and caches results — verified live: zip 28117 -> (35.584, -80.8685), zip 10001 -> (40.7484, -73.9967).
handleSync() in app/index.tsx calls geocodeZip BEFORE buildBlePayload BEFORE syncSettings — order is correct.

Legacy settings migration branch in index.tsx (lines 114-123) does NOT set trackFlight/flightIdent/showWeather/zipCode — could leave those undefined for very old v1 users. Low risk since it only triggers if v2 storage is empty AND legacy v1 exists with old team1/show1 keys.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payload contract verification. All 5 requested checks passed. UUIDs correct. Payload is flat with exactly 11 keys and correct types. Live JSON preview at testID='payload-preview' updates instantly on toggle/input edits. Zip 28117 default resolves to lat=35.584/lon=-80.8685; 10001 resolves to 40.7484/-73.9967. Actual BLE write requires native device build — not testable in web preview (expected).
